children: Asana, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $216.43M, a 9.9% increase from $196.94M in the prior-year quarter, while the company posted a net loss of ($39.19M) and diluted loss per share of ($0.17).
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue growth of 10% year-over-year was driven by new paying customers and a shift toward higher-priced Enterprise+ plans.
Core customers expanded to 26,778, with the core cohort contributing roughly 76–77% of revenue; customers paying >$100K increased to 890.
Product momentum included launches of AI Teammates and AI Studio and the acquisition of StackAI to boost no-code AI automation and agent capabilities.
Gross margin remained high at about 86–87%, supporting continued R&D and sales investments while non-GAAP operating loss narrowed.
Deferred revenue stood at $350.7M and the company reported strong operating cash generation to support product and go-to-market investments.
